## 7322351efef9

### A732-1 — Reproduced defect: a declared negative texture is admitted by `self_check` and cannot materialize a lesson

**Audited generator SHA-256:**
`dab0493eec756af5f8867862c6ae03a654b03e1004ea1e3dba7eeb8b4db661eb`.
**Canonical rule hash:** `655736d3766e`. No source was edited.

The source declares the invariant that the color-2 and color-3 seeds are not
4-adjacent, and lists `seeds_adjacent` under `DEGENERATE_TEXTURES`. However,
`AXES["texture"].valid` includes that value in the ordinary public domain, and
`self_check` verifies only that exactly one seed of each color exists.

A direct generated case with seed `10101`, sample index `0`, medium difficulty,
and `texture="seeds_adjacent"` places the 2-seed at `(3,3)` and 3-seed at `(3,4)`.
Their Manhattan distance is one, but `self_check` returns `[]`. The canonical
Racket rule executes successfully and produces a valid label, so the validator—not
the authority—is the mismatch. Exact input, source/rule hashes, positions and
validator result are in
`checks/audit/7322351efef9/adjacent-validator/metadata.json`; the public Racket
receipt is `.../racket.json`.

The stronger production symptom is reproducible through the public generator
command. Requesting one lesson with this exact texture accepts the first pair,
then rejects 19 subsequent draws as duplicates and exits nonzero with only 1/4
required pairs. The command and full failure are retained in
`checks/audit/7322351efef9/degenerate-admitted/console.log`. Thus an advertised
valid override silently enters a negative fixture that is both validator-clean
and incapable of supplying a normal 3-demo/1-query episode.

The standalone lint also reports a missing `RULE_HASH`; strict defect lint flags
four dead helpful textures, texture-domain overlap, and the fact that
`seeds_adjacent` passes `self_check`. Evidence is under
`checks/audit/7322351efef9/lint/` and `.../defect-lint/`.

**Classification:** reproduced generator-contract and validator defect. The
adjacent case is from an explicit documented degenerate override, not the default
sampler, so no claim is made that ordinary default lessons contain it.

**Suggested repair:** remove negative fixtures from the ordinary `texture` valid
domain (or expose them through a clearly diagnostic-only path), enforce the
non-adjacency invariant in `self_check`, pin the rule hash, and make each retained
helpful texture observably control seed geometry. Add an exact-override lesson
materialization regression.

**Checked:** generator source and metadata, all three canonical pairs, canonical
Racket authority, standalone lint/defect lint, direct exact override, validator
result, public Racket execution, and public 3-demo/1-query materialization. No
other semantic shortcut was established.

audits.resolution_reason: Reviewer-reported documented size endpoints rejected and geometry/palette controls inert; retained source-bound reference witnesses. Source not repaired.

## 7322351efef9

### Findings-only audit: reproduced control and validator defects

Audited unchanged generator version `1.1.1`, SHA-256
`dab0493eec756af5f8867862c6ae03a654b03e1004ea1e3dba7eeb8b4db661eb`.
The executed canonical Racket rule hash is `655736d3766e`; rule text SHA-256
`03d4a23301caf558b76ff871b0eaf8aeed93eff74bb36e5a158493ed8889c41a`.
No selected source was edited. These findings concern the audited target,
not the separate repair assignment.

**A732-2 — Declared valid grid-size endpoints are rejected.** `AXES` advertises
both `grid_h` and `grid_w` as valid in `5..14`. At seed `10101`, sample index
`0`, difficulty `medium`, all four exact overrides `{grid_h:5}`,
`{grid_h:14}`, `{grid_w:5}`, `{grid_w:14}` raise `ValueError` with the respective
override outside `[6, 9]`. The public draw gate uses the sampling band as its
override validity range. This is a concrete generator-control defect: four
documented-valid requests fail out of four tested. These failures produce no
grid, so validator and Racket output are inapplicable. Align the declared domain
with implementation, or let valid override sizes bypass narrower random bands.

**A732-3 — Helpful texture geometry controls have no effect.** For seed
`10101`, sample indices `0..2`, medium difficulty, each of the four declared
helpful textures (`default`, `horiz_seeds`, `vert_seeds`, `diag_seeds`) returns
an identical grid within each index: 12 calls, three unique inputs, and three
out of three groups with all four controls identical. At index `0`, seeds are
`2:(6,2)` and `3:(2,3)` on a `9x6` grid under every texture. Thus the explicit
horizontal and vertical requests produce neither corresponding geometry.
All 12 grids pass `self_check` and belong to the ordinary documented generated
domain. Actual Racket outputs for the four index-0 calls appear at indices
`0..3` in `racket.json`; all are valid and equal the separately marked Python
Manhattan mirror. The source also never reads `palette_kind`; this control
is an alias in metadata only. Make each retained control affect geometry, or
remove the unsupported public controls. The bounded measurements concern
`texture`; no separate `palette_kind` census was run.

**A732-1 — The retained adjacent-seed validator finding remains reproducible.**
At seed `10101`, index `0`, medium difficulty, exact override
`{texture:"seeds_adjacent"}`, generation returns seeds `2:(3,3)` and
`3:(3,4)` on a `7x7` grid. `self_check` returns `[]` despite the declared
non-adjacency invariant. Actual Racket execution (index `4` in `racket.json`)
succeeds and yields a valid output. This is one validator-admitted negative
fixture out of one tested. The override belongs to `AXES["texture"].valid`
but is explicitly listed among degenerate textures; it is outside the ordinary
invariant domain and not evidence of a default-sampler error. This independently
reproduces the open retained finding in `evidence/review_index.json`, without
repeating the prior lesson-materialization test. Separate diagnostic fixtures
from ordinary controls and enforce the non-adjacency invariant.

**A732-4 — The validator also admits a foreign background color.** A single
mutation of the seed-10101/index-0/default/medium grid changes cell `(0,0)`
from `0` to `9` while retaining exactly one seed of each color. `self_check`
returns `[]`, violating both the declared zero background and the summary's
otherwise-empty-grid contract. The mutation is not in the documented generated
domain and was not produced by `generate`; it is a validator probe only.
Racket output index `5` is valid and paints `(0,0)` as `0` because color `9`
is impassable, whereas the Python Manhattan mirror paints it `3`. This
one-cell mismatch establishes that validator admission extends beyond the
simple Manhattan domain. Reject colors outside `{0,2,3}` for this generator.

### Evidence and bounded scope

`checks/audit/7322351efef9/probe.json` records exact seeds, indices, difficulty,
overrides, generated grids, validator results, failures and Python mirror outputs.
`input.json` holds the six public-authority inputs in the order described above.
`racket.json` is the actual supported-CLI Racket receipt with source/rule hashes,
inputs and outputs. `comparison.json` distinguishes mirror observations from
authoritative results. `commands.json` records argv, working directory,
exit codes and evidence paths relative to `WORK`.

Inspected the current generator, notes, review index and all three usable
canonical pairs (two training pairs plus the verification test pair). The
Python Manhattan mirror fits 3/3 canonical pairs; this is mirror analysis,
not a fresh authoritative evaluation of those canonical inputs. Public Racket
execution produced valid outputs for 6/6 submitted inputs, representing three
unique grids (four repeated helpful-control inputs, one adjacent fixture,
one foreign-color mutation). No full battery or lesson census was run, and no
unrefuted semantic shortcut or lesson-identifiability claim was established.
This finite audit does not certify the remainder of the domain. Stop after these
concrete witnesses; preserve the audit target unchanged for maintainer triage.
